correctness.rationale: For k>=2 and r>=2, the powers (sigma,1)^k and ((sigma,1)(tau,0))^(k-1) independently generate the full counter because gcd(k,k-1)=1; cycle and adjacent transposition then generate S_k. Every group element has a positive word, proving reachability, two input minimalities, accepted-word stabilizer projection, quotient final set and quotient minimality. The unary low range comes from Rauch-Holzer, and both zero cases are explicit. Standalone finite checker replayed 45 parameter cases successfully.

value.rationale: The alphabet size is a meaningful structural complexity parameter: earlier unary bounds are finite, and the previously known unrestricted positive spectrum was witnessed by three letters. This closes the minimum alphabet threshold exactly at two for every positive input pair and provides an explicit clock-coupled two-generator group mechanism useful beyond this exact witness family.
